drivingQuestion: What is the 'ono' document that serves as the slave's emancipation?

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: הַמּוֹכֵר עַבְדּוֹ לַגּוֹיִם – יָצָא לְחֵירוּת, וְצָרִיךְ גֵּט שִׁחְרוּר מֵרַבּוֹ רִאשׁוֹן. אָמַר רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל: בַּמֶּה דְּבָרִים אֲמוּרִים – שֶׁלֹּא כָּתַב עָלָיו אוֹנוֹ, אֲבָל כָּתַב עָלָיו אוֹנוֹ – זֶהוּ שִׁחְרוּרוֹ.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «The Sages taught» (Tosefta, Avoda Zara 3:16): In a case of «one who sells his slave to gentiles,» the slave «is emancipated, but» nevertheless «requires a bill of manumission from his first master. Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said: In what» case «is this statement said? When» the master «did not write a document for him, but» if «he wrote a document for him,» then «this is his emancipation» and he does not require a bill of manumission.

segments.he: מַאי ״אוֹנוֹ״? אָמַר רַב שֵׁשֶׁת, דִּכְתַב לֵיהּ הָכִי: לִכְשֶׁתִּבְרַח מִמֶּנּוּ, אֵין לִי עֵסֶק בָּךְ.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «What» is the nature of this «document? Rav Sheshet said: He writes to him like this: When you will escape from» the gentile, «I have no business with you.» Even though this is not an explicit bill of manumission, it is sufficient for him to be considered a freeman.
